paragraphs.text: 1. MAY Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you according to the Law:
paragraphs.original: प्र वो ग्रावाणः सविता देवः सुवतु धर्मणा ।
paragraphs.translit: pra vo grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā |

paragraphs.text: Be harnessed to the shafts, and press.
2. Stones, drive calamity away, drive ye away malevolence:
Make ye the Cows our medicine.
3. Of one accord the upper Stones, giving the Bull his bull-like strength,
Look down with pride on those below.
4. May Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you as Law commands for him
paragraphs.original: ग्रावाणः सविता नु वो देवः सुवतु धर्मणा ।
paragraphs.translit: grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā |
